subject: 英语
description: 五年级上册英语核心知识点精华总结

cards.title: 描述人物性格
cards.definition: 用形容词描述人物的外貌和性格特征。
core_points: 外貌：young年轻 old年老 tall高 short矮 funny滑稽
性格：kind善良 strict严格 polite礼貌 helpful乐于助人 hard-working勤奋 clever聪明 shy害羞
Who's your English teacher? Mr/Miss/Mrs + 姓
What's he/she like? 他/她什么样？— He's tall and funny.

mistakes.wrong: What does he like?（意思变了）
mistakes.correct: What's he LIKE?=他什么样（性格外貌），What does he like?=他喜欢什么
funny是形容词不加a: He is funny.（如果当名词：He is a funny person.）

cards.memory_tip: 👩‍🏫 What's he LIKE = 他「像」什么样 = 描述性格; What does he LIKE = 他「喜欢」什么 = 问爱好

cards.title: 星期与课程表
cards.definition: 一周七天的英语说法和描述课程安排。
core_points: Monday周一 Tuesday周二 Wednesday周三 Thursday周四 Friday周五 Saturday周六 Sunday周日
星期首字母都大写，前面用on: on Monday
What do you have on Mondays? 周一有什么课？— We have Chinese, English and maths.
What do you do on weekends? 周末你做什么？— I often read books.

example.question: What do you have on Wednesdays?
example.answer: We have English, science and PE.

mistakes.correct: 星期几首字母必须大写：Wednesday

cards.memory_tip: 📅 星期记忆口诀：Mon(门)月 Tue(兔)火 Wed(蛙)水 Thu(树)木 Fri(飞)金 Sat(杀)土 Sun(日)天

cards.title: 日常活动频率词
cards.definition: 表示做事频率的副词和日常活动表达。
core_points: 频率词：always总是 usually通常 often经常 sometimes有时 never从不
频率词放在be动词后，实义动词前
日常活动：wash my clothes洗衣服 watch TV看电视 do homework做作业 read books读书 play football踢足球
Do you often...? 你经常...吗？

example.question: What do you often do on weekends?
example.answer: I often play football and sometimes watch TV.

mistakes.wrong: I often am happy.（频率词位置错）

mistakes.correct: I often play football.（实义动词前）

cards.memory_tip: 🎯 频率从高到低：always(100%) > usually(80%) > often(60%) > sometimes(30%) > never(0%)

cards.title: 食物偏好与健康
cards.definition: 更丰富的食物词汇和表达健康饮食。
core_points: 食物：sandwich三明治 hamburger汉堡 salad沙拉 ice cream冰淇淋 tea茶
味道：delicious美味 fresh新鲜 sweet甜 hot辣 healthy健康 favourite最喜欢
What's your favourite food? 你最爱吃什么？— My favourite food is noodles.
What would you like to eat/drink? 你想吃/喝什么？

example.question: What's your favourite food?
example.answer: My favourite food is hamburgers. They're delicious!

mistakes.wrong: My favourite food is hamburger.（忘复数）
mistakes.correct: 表示种类泛指用复数：My favourite food is hamburgers.
两种都对！favourite是英式，favorite是美式

cards.memory_tip: 🍔 favourite = fav(最爱) + our(我们的) + ite → 我们最爱的东西

cards.title: 房间与家具方位
cards.definition: 房间名称、家具词汇和There be句型。
core_points: 房间：bedroom卧室 living room客厅 kitchen厨房 bathroom浴室 study书房
家具：bed床 sofa沙发 table桌子 clock钟 photo照片 plant植物 bike自行车
There is + 单数/不可数: There is a clock on the wall.
There are + 复数: There are two bedrooms in my house.

example.question: 描述你的卧室
steps: There are two photos on the wall.
There is a desk beside the bed.
example.answer: There is a bed and a desk in my bedroom. There are two photos on the wall.

mistakes.wrong: There are a book on the desk.
mistakes.correct: 单数用is: There IS a book on the desk.
表示「有」用There is/are，不用There have

cards.memory_tip: 🏠 There be就近原则：There is a pen and two books.（靠近is的a pen是单数→用is）
